name: Aphelion of Ceres
description:
[blue]Eclipses[/blue] Slingshot and Newton's Meteor. Blocks fired by Slingshots instead fire as meteors, and your meteors apply the damage and effects their block would when fired by a Slingshot, then crumble after 3 hits.

The behavior of the eclipsed object is replaced while wearing this Aphelion.

[gray]At home's comfort, guiding the flock.[/gray]
